numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterBinding.jsonsc.description: AdapterBinding is one provider installation serving a port.

instance.description: instance is required: the configured instance of the provider (one provider may serve several, such as two CI servers).

provider.description: provider is required: the extension id of a provider of the port, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterBinding.jsonsc.title: Adapter Binding

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterPorts.jsonsche.description:
AdapterPorts binds the ports that reach customer systems; a port added later is a new
 optional field. Each binding is replaced as a unit, never pairing one scope's provider with another's instance.

knowledge.description:
knowledge names the KnowledgeConnection objects the scope may read; a narrower scope's list replaces the wider one.
 Deprecated in 1.3.0: a knowledge source is an MCP-backed plugin named in AdapterSelectorSpec.tools (design sections 14 and 17).

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterPorts.jsonsche.title: Adapter Ports

overrides.description:
overrides pins, per verb, a provider other than the one bound for the verb's port (design section 8; the resolution
 order of section 17 puts a provider pinned by the customer first). A key is a verb name of dot-joined ASCII
 identifiers ("scm.CreatePullRequest"), at most 253 bytes; each value is replaced as a unit, and a narrower scope's
 map replaces the wider one. An empty map overrides nothing.

ports.description: ports is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot. An empty ports binds nothing: a valid no-op.

tools.description:
tools names the plugin installations whose tool capabilities (tool.<plugin>.<name>) the scope may grant to a
 harness, unique by plugin and instance; a narrower scope's list replaces the wider one. It replaces the knowledge
 list of ports, which named KnowledgeConnection objects (deprecated in 1.3.0).

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterTool.jsonschem.description: AdapterTool is one plugin installation whose tools the scope may use.

instance.description: instance is required: the configured instance of the plugin (one plugin may serve several connections).

plugin.description: plugin is required: the extension id of a plugin that exposes tool capabilities, which must resolve to a lockfile entry.

numinance.kinds.v1.AdapterTool.jsonschem.title: Adapter Tool
